notes.title: Important update on The Vigilante Diaries’ launch date
notes.notes:
Hello, vigilantes!

First of all, we would like to thank you for your continued support. We're very happy to see that so many of you are excited to play this adventure. It means a lot to us.

Now, onto the big news: we have made the hard decision to [b]delay the launch[/b] of The Vigilante Diaries, but for a [b]very good reason[/b].

Currently, we have a [b]big unannounced project[/b] on our hands, so we had to make adjustments in the team and shift most of our focus and resources to that. That’s why The Vigilante Diaries had to take the backseat for a while.

Once again, we want to stress that this is just [b]temporary[/b], and that The Vigilante Diaries is still moving forward and we’re still making progress on the game. This story is something we’re very passionate about and we want you guys to experience it too.

Thank you for your understanding and support, and we hope we will be able to share more news and advancements with you very soon!

And we hope you will be as excited about the new project as we are!
